custodian.note: Tuning workers get development fixtures and this protocol, never the untouched labels or seeds.

population.grouping_rule: Group by generator family, producer/layout and shared source ancestry; a cover/no-cover twin and all seed variations stay in one split. Public/demo and development groups and their generated siblings never enter the untouched claim denominator.
population.note: Measurement design target from planning/quality/EVALUATION.md; the held-out corpus is generated under custodian control and is not an existing dataset. Different generator implementations, typography and layouts are required, not 600 cosmetic variants of the public amount sample.

evaluation.note: Held-out corpus manifest is generated and pinned under custodian control; it is never committed with labels and its groups must not intersect development/public_demo lineages (verify-splits enforces).

permissioned.note: Optional small real incidents: consent-bound, permissioned, digest-pinned; same custody rules as evaluation and additionally require consent_ref per page.

rules: Label payloads are never committed to any checkout or copied into task artifacts.
Labels resolve only through scripts/evaluate_inspector.py --label-root or INKFLIP_EVAL_LABEL_ROOT, to a directory outside the repository.
The pinned sha256 and label_count must match exactly; unattested or stale labels fail closed.
Artifacts carry digests and aggregate counts only; the serializer refuses label content.

candidate_freeze.note: Freeze the candidate commit/lock/model/configuration before evaluating. A failure used to tune a candidate retires that case from untouched claims and requires a new evaluation version.

targets.note: 100% contractual hard fixtures; zero wrong-file/page or fabricated precise anchors.
Useful localized precision >=0.95 on at least 100 emitted evaluated findings, adjudicated by two blinded reviewers.
>=0.90 over predeclared supported cases; abstentions, unsupported checks and timeouts remain in the denominator.
Mean <=0.05 surfaced non-informational false alerts per clean page.
p95 <=2 CSS px on independent fiducials at reference zoom/DPR.
max <=4 CSS px on independent fiducials.
100% repeated-occurrence preservation on supported hard duplicate fixtures.
100% planned checks reach a terminal result; missing or nonterminal is never agreement.
Identical semantic digests on repeated same-environment supported fixtures, or an explicit nondeterminism block.

retirement_policy: A case used to tune a candidate leaves the untouched claim denominator and a new evaluation version is issued; archive negative results and denominators.
public_boundary: Public demonstration cases and their generated siblings never enter the untouched claim denominator.

diagnosis.comparison: Randomized/counterbalanced task comparison against a PDF viewer plus raw text dump
diagnosis.targets: >=4/5 early testers understanding the result without calling it fraud/safety proof; >=30% median diagnosis-time improvement on repeated relevant tasks without correctness loss
